# Chucao

> Kit de marca + sistema de diseño web de devsChile

## Getting Started

- [README](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/README.md): Documentación principal del proyecto
- [Design System](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/DESIGN.md): Sistema de diseño y marca
- [Changelog](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/CHANGELOG.md): Historial de cambios

## Components

- [ch-accordion](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-accordion/): ch-accordion component
- [ch-alert](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-alert/): Block-level status message.
- [ch-badge](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-badge/): Small status label.
- [ch-button](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-button/): graph TD;
- [ch-card](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-card/): ch-card component
- [ch-checkbox](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-checkbox/): ch-checkbox component
- [ch-cluster](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-cluster/): Horizontal flow that wraps when it runs out of room, with a token-driven
- [ch-description-list](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-description-list/): Label/value pairs for detail views, on a native `<dl>`.
- [ch-divider](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-divider/): ch-divider component
- [ch-drawer](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-drawer/): Sliding side panel for navigation, editing forms and quick detail views.
- [ch-emoji](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-emoji/): Inline emoji from the devsChile CDN.
- [ch-empty-state](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-empty-state/): The standard "there is nothing here" block: an optional visual, a title, a
- [ch-grid](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-grid/): Responsive grid of equal cells.
- [ch-icon](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-icon/): A single Lucide glyph.
- [ch-icon-button](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-icon-button/): A button whose only content is an icon.
- [ch-input](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-input/): ch-input component
- [ch-link](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-link/): ch-link component
- [ch-modal](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-modal/): Modal dialog, built on the native `<dialog>` element and opened with
- [ch-page-header](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-page-header/): The heading block at the top of a page: title, optional eyebrow and
- [ch-radio](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-radio/): ch-radio component
- [ch-segmented-control](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-segmented-control/): Compact control for switching between a few mutually exclusive options
- [ch-select](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-select/): ch-select component
- [ch-skeleton](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-skeleton/): Decorative loading placeholder that reserves the space real content will
- [ch-spinner](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-spinner/): Loading indicator.
- [ch-stack](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-stack/): Vertical flow: children stack top to bottom with a token-driven gap.
- [ch-switch](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-switch/): ch-switch component
- [ch-tabs](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-tabs/): ch-tabs component
- [ch-textarea](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-textarea/): ch-textarea component
- [ch-timeline](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-timeline/): Chronological history: a native ordered list with a marker dot per item
- [ch-tooltip](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-tooltip/): Short help text shown on hover and on focus.
